Inspected 03_deliverables/04_correlations.md and 03_deliverables/05_macro_model.md, confirming identical cascading prepend corruption in Table 15 (9 repetitions) and Table 19 (8 repetitions).

Formulated canonical 3-column prefix architecture (Column 1: 'ردیف', Column 2: 'متغیر', Column 3: 'مؤلفه') and mapped complete row-by-row cell contents for Table 13, Table 15, Table 16, Table 19, and Table 24.
